  • Paint the vision of Payload within the Figma Platform and guide customers in realizing the value through product demonstrations and presentations
  • Support the Sales team by addressing Payload and Figma platform questions and showcasing how Payload accelerates digital product development to customers
  • Own the customer IT and Security relationship during the deal cycle by addressing security questionnaires and enterprise  requirements, in order to help customers adopt the platform securely and at scale
  • Collaborate with Product and Support to identify opportunities for enhancing account security through new product features and help influence the product roadmap
  • Design and scale technical sales efforts, facilitating conversations and connections between our customers, sales and product teams
  • Deliver timely technical support to customers and agency partners building on Payload, ensuring smooth adoption and issue resolution
  • Collaborate with amazing Figmates to hone your craft and execute daily. We are looking for fantastic life-long learners who can operate with autonomy

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 4+ years in Sales Engineering or Solutions Consulting within a SaaS environment
  • Strong ability to position technology in a pre-sales capacity by defining success criteria, leading product evaluations, and guiding customers through technical decision-making
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor product demonstrations and technical discussions for both technical and business audiences
  • Solid understanding of the enterprise SaaS ecosystem, frontend development, and modern developer workflows and lifecycles
  • Proven ability to quickly learn new technologies while effectively managing competing customer priorities and balancing business objectives

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience using or working with Payload, or other CMS/DXP experience
  • You embody our values and can thrive in a constantly evolving and growing environment

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Technical Account Managers work cross-functionally to support the largest and most complex Stripe users. Through trusted relationships, we offer customized, strategic consultations and proactively identify opportunity areas to help businesses deliver more value to their customers, optimize technical operations on their teams, and accelerate their global growth with Stripe.

What you'll do

Responsibilities

  • Provide a Gold Standard Experience to your assigned accounts' key stakeholders
  • Work with the wider Operations team to provide current state, resources, and knowledge to enable Gold Standard Experience across teams interacting directly with the user via support channels, external documentation, or product and feature feedback or development

Who you are

  • Fluent business level Chinese
  • Strong product sense and a drive to solve difficult, user-related problems
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to lead complex integration conversations in a highly consultative and proactive manner

  • An operations-savvy mindset, with the ability to identify and eliminate process friction while continuing to build scalable processes
  • Experience in small-to-medium-scale project management
  • Strong organizational skills and self-starting mindset
  • Experience with tools like Postman, Xcode, Python, Webhooks, and ETL
  • Experience in the payments industry

Location: London

At Databricks, our core values are at the heart of everything we do; a culture of proactiveness and a customer-centric mindset guide us to build a unified platform that makes data science and analytics accessible to everyone.   • Form successful relationships with clients throughout your assigned territory to provide technical and business value in collaboration with an Account Executive and a Senior Solutions Architect.

  • Become a Big Data Analytics advisor on aspects of architecture and design.

  • Develop both technically and in pre-sales, with the goal of becoming an independently operating Solutions Architect.

What we look for:

  • Experience, technical customer-facing and with a background in Data Science / Generative AI / Machine Learning / Data Warehousing or Data Engineering.  
  • You will be working in the following any of the following vertical sectors: 
    • Real-money Gaming, Sports, Entertainment, Media, Telco and/or Hospitality.
    • Manufacturing, Energy, Utilities and Industrials
    • Travel, Transport and Logistics
    • Financial Services and Insurance
    • Public Sector
    • Consumer Package Goods (CPG) / Retail
  • Any experience in Pre-sales or post-sales experience working with external clients
  • Familiarity with working with clients, creating a narrative, answering customer questions, aligning the agenda with important interests, and achieving tangible outcomes.
  • Ability to independently deliver a technical proposition, identify customers' pain points and explain important areas for business value to develop a trusted advisor skillset.
  • Code in a core programming language such as Python, Java, or Scala.
  • Knowledgeable in a core Big Data Analytics domain with some exposure to advanced proofs-of-concept and an understanding of a major public cloud platform (AWS, GCP, Azure).

  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, modern application architectures, observability, and/or DevOps technologies.
  • Comfortable independently leading technical presentations, product demonstrations, and evaluations.
  • Able to translate technical capabilities into meaningful business outcomes for customers.
  • Effective communicating with both technical practitioners (Developers, SREs, Platform Engineers, Operations teams) and business stakeholders.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple customer stakeholders while managing several active evaluations simultaneously.
  • Curious, adaptable, and eager to continually learn and expand technical expertise.
  • Experience with modern infrastructure technologies, such as cloud platforms, containers, Kubernetes, microservices, networking, and/or operating systems.
  • Able to sit for up to 4 hours while traveling to and from client sites.
  • Able to travel via auto, train, or air up to 25% of the time.
